name: Nintendo
hook: A Japanese card company that became the biggest name in video games, with Mario at the center.

facts.label: 1983 console
facts.statement: Nintendo is the Japanese company behind Donkey Kong. It introduced its first home console in Japan in 1983 and moved its U.S. base near Seattle in 1982.

facts.label: Mario
facts.statement: Mario started as Jumpman in Donkey Kong. Nintendo named its mascot after the landlord of its first U.S. warehouse, and he starred in 1985's Super Mario Bros.

facts.label: Donkey Kong
facts.statement: Shigeru Miyamoto designed Donkey Kong, the 1981 arcade game that introduced Mario; much of the design work happened in a company bathtub.

facts.label: Game Boy
facts.statement: The Game Boy was Nintendo's black-and-white handheld, later sold in a 1998 color version and succeeded by the DS; it entered the National Toy Hall of Fame in 2009.

facts.label: Wii
facts.statement: The Wii, released in 2006, was Nintendo's home console that pioneered motion-sensor controls with bowling, boxing and more.

facts.label: Pokémon
facts.statement: Pokémon began as Nintendo's "Pocket Monsters" and grew into a game series where Ponyta evolves into the fiery Rapidash.

facts.label: Animal Crossing
facts.statement: Animal Crossing: New Horizons, a 2020 Switch game, has the raccoon Tom Nook running the in-game business.
